visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of quick links, each a centered outline icon, small label and a text link
visualCharacteristics.description: White band, 4 columns (1/2/4 responsive). Each item centered: thin-line outline icon, small grey label, underlined blue bold link below.

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, one row per item: cell 1 = icon or image, cell 2 = label paragraph + link

usage: 1/2/4-column responsive grid without card chrome. Links render as text links, not buttons.
reuseGuidance: Use for icon-led quick-link rows. For photo article teasers use `cards-article`.
